exam_rules: Closed-book. No notes or reference materials. On-screen calculator for applicable exams. Proctor monitors throughout.
id_requirements: One valid government-issued photo ID with full name. Name must match Pearson VUE registration exactly.

lifecycle.summary: Confirmed current on the issuer host on 2026-09-19: Oracle MyLearn's page 'Exam 1Z0-082: Oracle Database Administration I' offers the exam ('Delivery Proctored Online', 'Duration 120 Minutes', 'Number of Questions 72', 'Passing Score 60%', 'Register for online exam'): 'An Oracle Database Administration 2019 Certified Professional has proven theoretical understanding of and the practical skills required to configure and manage Oracle Databases up to and including Oracle 19c. Passing this first exam in the two exam path proves your skills in SQL programming skills, database and network administration.' The certification path prints 'Step 1 - Pass Exam Oracle Database 23ai Administration Associate (OR) Oracle Database Administration I Step 2 - Pass Exam Oracle Database Administration II 1Z0-083'.

renewal_options: Oracle certifications are version-specific. When Oracle releases a new database/platform version, a new exam version is typically released. Previous certifications remain valid as earned.

retake_policy.notes: 14-day waiting period after failed attempt. Maximum 3 attempts per exam in a 12-month period. Full exam fee required for each retake.
